name: bitbucket
description: Bitbucket Cloud integration — list repositories, browse and review pull requests (details, approvals, unified diffs), read files at any ref, list Pipelines runs, and add pull request comments for a workspace. Authenticates with HTTP Basic using your Atlassian account email plus a scoped Atlassian API token (app passwords were retired 2026-07-28).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Bitbucket Cloud repositories, pull requests, and Pipelines

fields.label: Atlassian Account Email
fields.helpText: The email of your Atlassian account (used as the Basic auth username — not your Bitbucket username).

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: A scoped Atlassian API token with the Bitbucket scopes read:account, read:repository:bitbucket, read:pullrequest:bitbucket, write:pullrequest:bitbucket, and read:pipeline:bitbucket. Tokens expire (max 1 year).

tools.name: bitbucket.list_repos
tools.description: List repositories in the workspace, most recently updated first. Optionally filter with a Bitbucket query expression.

query.description: Bitbucket filter query (e.g. name ~ "api" or language = "python")

tools.name: bitbucket.list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository, optionally filtered by state.

state.description: Filter by pull request state (default OPEN)

limit.description: Max pull requests to return (default 25, max 50)

tools.name: bitbucket.get_pull_request
tools.description: Get details of a pull request, including its reviewers and a participants/approval summary.

tools.name: bitbucket.get_pr_diff
tools.description: Get the unified diff of a pull request as plain text (truncated to about 100 KB with a truncated flag).

tools.name: bitbucket.get_file
tools.description: Read a file's raw contents from a repository at a given ref (branch, tag, or commit). Capped at about 256 KB with a truncated flag.

ref.description: Branch name, tag, or commit hash (e.g. main)

path.description: File path within the repository (e.g. src/app.py)

tools.name: bitbucket.list_pipeline_runs
tools.description: List Bitbucket Pipelines runs for a repository, most recent first, with state, result, and target branch.

limit.description: Max pipeline runs to return (default 25, max 50)

tools.name: bitbucket.add_pr_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a pull request (additive; does not modify code or PR state).
